summary: Motei & Associates has 20+ years of reputation and a clean layout. The homepage does not turn visitors into consultations yet, and visible errors weaken the trust a law firm depends on.

findings.problem: The proof counters (Cases, Sucess Rate, Countries) show 0 or Over 0 on the page, and no testimonials or named awards appear on the homepage.
findings.cost: A client choosing a lawyer looks for proof first. Zeros and empty claims read as a firm with no track record.
findings.fix: Working counters with your real numbers, plus named client testimonials and awards.

findings.problem: The E-LAWYER booking link sits in the header only. The hero has no main button, and WhatsApp is a small icon.
findings.cost: A prospect who is ready to enquire has no obvious next step and moves to the next firm in the search results.
findings.fix: One clear Book a Consultation button above the fold, with WhatsApp beside it.

findings.problem: Typos: Sucess Rate, Estate Planing in the menu and dropdown, Dispute Resolution text cut off mid word, and 22 years in one place and 23 in another.
findings.cost: A law firm sells precision. Small errors make clients doubt the care taken with their case.
findings.fix: A proofread build with one consistent set of facts.

findings.problem: The whole Services block appears twice, three menus repeat, and Real Estate links to two different pages.
findings.cost: Repeated and doubled pages confuse visitors and split your Google ranking between pages.
findings.fix: One clean structure, one page per service, written to rank for searches clients actually make.

redesign: A proof first homepage: real numbers, named partners, client testimonials and awards near every enquiry button.
One tap booking and WhatsApp on every page, so an enquiry takes under 30 seconds on a phone.
A page per practice area, written to rank for searches like corporate lawyer Dubai and DIFC wills.
